message:
Running command: python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
# f has many live locals to make each recursive frame large; at base tailcalls tiny g with many locals fsize large? actually callee fsize matters for overflow in pretailcall
for nf in [50,100,180,220]:
  locals_str=','.join('a%d'%i for i in range(nf)); zeros=','.join('0' for _ in range(nf))
  # references a0 after recursion to keep locals live? compiler may still allocate them.
  for n in [1000,3000,5000,8000,12000,20000,40000]:
    src=f"local function g() local {locals_str}={zeros}; return 1 end\nlocal function t() return g() end\nlocal function f(n) local {locals_str}={zeros}; if n==0 then return t() else return a0+f(n-1) end end\nf({n})\n"
    Path(f'/tmp/poc_nf{nf}_n{n}.lua').write_text(src)
PY
for f in /tmp/poc_nf*_n*.lua; do b=$(basename $f); ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0:abort_on_error=0 timeout 5 /tmp/lua-build/fuzz_lua $f >/tmp/o 2>/tmp/e; r=$?; m=$(grep -m1 -E 'ERROR: AddressSanitizer|stack overflow|too many|attempt' /tmp/e); echo "$b exit:$r $m"; if grep -q 'AddressSanitizer' /tmp/e; then head -80 /tmp/e; break; fi; done
